# The Wolf Crest Real Estate

> The Wolf Crest Real Estate is a Dubai property advisory based in Al Garhoud, Dubai, UAE. It handles luxury residential sales and leasing, off-plan and new developments, investment advisory and end-to-end client representation, and guides buyers from India investing in Dubai. Tagline: "Where Power Meets Prestige".

## Services

- Luxury Residential Sales & Leasing: villas, penthouses and signature apartments across Dubai's most sought-after communities. Valuation and pricing strategy, private and off-market listings, qualified buyer and tenant screening, negotiation through to transfer.
- Off-Plan & New Developments: early access to Dubai's most anticipated launches. Priority allocation at launch, developer and project due diligence, payment plan structuring, snagging and handover support.
- Investment Advisory: data-led guidance for building a UAE property portfolio. Yield and capital growth analysis, portfolio planning and review, market and community research, resale and exit strategy.
- End-to-End Client Representation: one dedicated advisor from the first conversation to handover. Mortgage and conveyancing coordination, documentation and DLD transfer, after-sale and property management support.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does The Wolf Crest Real Estate do?
It is a Dubai real estate advisory for buying, selling and leasing luxury homes, buying off-plan property from developers, and property investment advice in the UAE, with one advisor representing the client from start to handover.

### Where is The Wolf Crest office?
Office No. B6, next to Al Garhoud Hospital, behind the DHL Warehouse, Al Garhoud, Dubai, UAE, close to GGICO Metro Station.

### How do I contact The Wolf Crest?
Call +971 50 420 8578 (UAE) or +91 91485 58578 (India), email info@thewolfcrest.com, or use the contact options on https://thewolfcrest.com/dubai-property-connect. Advisors usually reply fastest on WhatsApp at +91 91485 58578.

### Can I buy Dubai property from India?
Yes. The Wolf Crest helps buyers in India, including Mangaluru and NRIs, invest in Dubai and guides them remotely from the first questions through to handover.

### What is off-plan property in Dubai?
Off-plan means buying directly from the developer before the building is complete, usually at launch prices with a payment plan spread over construction. The Wolf Crest checks the developer's track record, delivery timeline and community before recommending a unit, then manages the reservation, payment milestones and handover.

### Which Dubai developers does The Wolf Crest work with?
Developer partners include Emaar Properties, DAMAC Properties, Sobha Realty, Nakheel, Meraas, Danube Properties, Binghatti, Ellington Properties, Azizi Developments, Omniyat, Arada, Deyaar, wasl and others listed above.

### Does The Wolf Crest help with renting or leasing in Dubai?
Yes. It leases luxury residences for tenants and manages lettings for landlords.

### Can buying property in Dubai lead to a UAE Golden Visa?
Property investment can qualify buyers for the UAE 10-year Golden Visa if the investment meets the government's criteria. The Wolf Crest can check eligibility as part of its advice.

### Who founded The Wolf Crest Real Estate?
Godwin Dsouza (Founder & CEO) and Pooja Preetham (Co-founder).
